name: exploded-portafilter-gpt-6-luna-s2-r7
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of an espresso machine portafilter, as an SVG. Use a double-spout portafilter with a removable basket rather than a bottomless one.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="900" viewBox="0 0 1200 900">

  <linearGradient id="steelSide" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop stop-color="#63757c"/><stop offset=".25" stop-color="#d4dcda"/><stop offset=".58" stop-color="#829399"/><stop offset=".82" stop-color="#eff1ed"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#71838a"/></linearGradient>
  <linearGradient id="basket" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2=".2"><stop stop-color="#71848b"/><stop offset=".23" stop-color="#e2e7e3"/><stop offset=".52" stop-color="#9aa9aa"/><stop offset=".8" stop-color="#f5f5ef"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#77898f"/></linearGradient>

  <pattern id="perfs" width="18" height="13" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><circle cx="5" cy="5" r="2.1" fill="#52636a"/><circle cx="14" cy="11" r="1.7" fill="#66777b"/></pattern>
  <pattern id="brushed" width="5" height="18" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse"><path d="M1 0v18" stroke="#fff" stroke-opacity=".13"/><path d="M3 0v18" stroke="#526269" stroke-opacity=".08"/></pattern>

  .ink{stroke:#273940;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
  .fine{fill:none;stroke:#455960;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
  .label{font:600 15px 'Arial',sans-serif;letter-spacing:1.45px;fill:#263b42}
  .sub{font:12px 'Arial',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.7px;fill:#657579}
  .num{font:700 11px 'Arial',sans-serif;fill:#f7f4ec}
